source_caption_text:
Blueface officially proposed to Chrisean Rock on stream in the club 💍💍

Congrats!!

Blueface has officially proposed to Chrisean Rock during a nightclub outing, getting down on one knee as a “Will You Marry Me” sign appeared above them. Chrisean looked excited and embraced him as the moment played out on Blueface’s Kick livestream. She appeared to accept, though a ring wasn’t clearly visible in the footage, and the two haven’t announced a wedding date.

The proposal comes after another reunion for the couple. They first met in 2020 through Blueface’s Blue Girls Club series and later starred together in the reality show Blueface & Chrisean: Crazy in Love. Their relationship has had several public breakups and reconciliations, and Chrisean recently moved back into Blueface’s home.

They share a son, Chrisean Jr., born in September 2023. Blueface is also a father to children from previous relationships, including two with Jaidyn Alexis. For now, the nightclub moment has fans wondering whether the couple will take the next step and make their commitment official.
